components.name: Primary Next Button
components.description: Next step trigger with leftward arrow animation in RTL.
components.css: .ds-btn-next { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 8px; padding: 14px 24px; background: linear-gradient(135deg, #2563eb, #1d4ed8); color: #fff; border: none; border-radius: 6px; font-weight: 700; font-family: Vazirmatn, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; transition: all 0.18s ease; } .ds-btn-next:hover { background: linear-gradient(135deg, #1d4ed8, #1e40af); transform: translateY(-2px); } .ds-btn-next:hover .ds-arrow { transform: translateX(-4px); } .ds-arrow { transition: transform 0.18s ease; }

components.name: Secondary Prev Button
components.description: Previous step trigger with rightward arrow animation in RTL.
components.css: .ds-btn-prev { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 8px; padding: 14px 22px; background: linear-gradient(135deg, #475569, #334155); color: #e2e8f0; border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.08); border-radius: 6px; font-weight: 500; font-family: Vazirmatn, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; transition: all 0.18s ease; } .ds-btn-prev:hover { background: linear-gradient(135deg, #334155, #1e293b); color: #fff; transform: translateY(-2px); } .ds-btn-prev:hover .ds-arrow { transform: translateX(4px); } .ds-arrow { transition: transform 0.18s ease; }

rules.name: The Single Accent Rule
rules.body: The primary blue accent (#3b82f6) is preserved exclusively for interactive forward actions and focal identifiers.

rules.name: The Persian Digit Rule
rules.body: Numbers inside general Persian prose utilize localized Persian numerals (۰-۹), while tracking codes enforce LTR formatting.

rules.name: Zero Blur on Large Viewports
rules.body: Never use backdrop-filter blur on large cards, hero panels, or scrollable surfaces.

dos: Do maintain standard 2.0px stroke-width on all SVG glyphs.
Do point forward navigation arrows to the Left (←) and backward arrows to the Right (→) in RTL mode.
Do wrap decorative elongated Persian headings in .persian-tatweel-wrapper with .tatweel-sr for screen readers.
donts: Don't mix multiple icon sets or introduce emoji icons inside critical UI buttons.
Don't use pure black #000000 for dark mode surfaces.
Don't put comments in code files.
